result:
Lint is clean. All fixes are in place:

1. **Reserved/short/non-Latin names** (`src/lib/slug.ts`, `src/server/services/organization-service.ts`, `src/server/services/auth-service.ts`): sign-up now passes the raw display name through `createOrganization(..., { deriveSlug: true })`, which skips `assertValidSlug`'s hard throw and relies on `uniqueSlug` — now also rejecting slugs shorter than the minimum length — to always produce a valid, non-reserved, deduplicated slug.
2. **Case-insensitive email** (`src/server/repositories/user-repository.ts`): `findUserByEmail`/`insertUser` now lowercase defensively at the repository boundary instead of only relying on the Zod schema.
3. **Rate limiting** (`src/lib/rate-limit.ts`, `src/server/services/auth-service.ts`): added an `auth:register` bucket and a dedicated `auth:login` bucket (previously falling through to the generic default), and `register()` now consumes the limit before writing anything.
4. **Error classification** (`src/lib/errors.ts`): added `ConflictError`/`RateLimitedError` domain classes mapped to `conflict`/`rate_limited` so duplicate-email and throttled attempts no longer surface as generic `internal_error`/"Something went wrong".
5. **Oversized workspace name** (`src/server/services/auth-service.ts`): `workspaceNameFor()` truncates the display name so `"<name>'s workspace"` always fits the 64-character org name limit.
